text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Interethnic tensions continue to be the main threat to Macedonia's stability, says U.N. Secretary General Boutros Boutros-Ghali in a report in which he request the extension of the UNPREDEP mandate.

- Macedonia's change from summer time at the end of September and not on October 27 as agreed by European countries caused great problems to its railways and economy. The government asks ecnomy ministry to explain why it did not observe the EU recommendation.
- Macedonia is ready to open its embassy in Ottawa and a consulate in Toronto.
- Australia supports Macedonia's candidacy for non-permanent Security Council member.
- Macedonian parliament adopted rules for media presentation of political parties at the the forhtcoming local elections. Disputes with ethnic Albanian parties over the use of language.
